name: medlims

scripts.obfuscate: npx javascript-obfuscator dist/assets --output dist/assets --compact true --string-array true --self-defending true --dead-code-injection false
scripts.dist:win7-x86: npm run build && npm run obfuscate && electron-builder --config electron-builder-win7.json --win --ia32
scripts.dist:win10-x86: npm run build && npm run obfuscate && electron-builder --config electron-builder-win10.json --win --ia32
scripts.dist:win10-x64: npm run build && npm run obfuscate && electron-builder --config electron-builder-win10.json --win --x64
scripts.dist:win10-both: npm run build && npm run obfuscate && electron-builder --config electron-builder-win10.json --win --ia32 --x64

author: Bryce Men Kenk C. Ablir, RMT
